content:
The weekend is approaching, Amazon is holding a massive Labor Day sale, AirPods Pro 3 is also continuing to drop by $50, while Best Buy has updated its promotions with new deals, and we have also found some new great recommendations elsewhere. The 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR is still at an all-time low on Amazon, dropping by $329; the standard Studio Display is also at an all-time low; Apple's official refurbished units also have discounts of up to $500. In addition, don't miss this Midnight Black 16GB/1TB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, which is $150 off on Amazon; there's also a brand-new Dark Cherry smart display charging series that can match your new iPhone 18 Pro — with several eye-catching launch deals coming up. See below for details.

Amazon's 2026 massive Labor Day sale officially begins! Thousands of deals: Apple, Android, TVs, tech products under $100, and even bargains under $5

Best Buy updates massive Labor Day sale, adds new deals: OLED TVs down $800, Apple, Galaxy phones, home appliances extra $1,000 off, more deals coming

Amazon launches the best AirPods Pro 3 deal of Labor Day weekend, $50 off

Best Buy has updated its massive Labor Day promotion, but Amazon has also injected some brand-new deals to counter this competitor's promotion, with the most notable being $50 off the Apple AirPods Pro 3. We still don't expect Apple to release a new generation of Pro earbuds this month, so this Pro 3 deal can be said to be one of the best Labor Day deals of the year.

Amazon is currently selling AirPods Pro 3 for $199 (shipping included). Original price $249, a straight $50 off — if you're not buying one of the best, most popular ANC earbuds, it certainly is one of them.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (original price $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)
  • AirPods 4 Amazon Resale $79 (original price $129)

Midnight Black 16GB/1TB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air drops $150 on Amazon today

Deals on brand-new M5 MacBook Air have appeared here and there, but it has been on and off since the price increase a few months ago. However, today, as part of the Labor Day promotion, Amazon is selling this Midnight Black 13-inch model at a $150 discount.

Amazon is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,449 (shipping included).

This is the Midnight Black model, which Apple and other retailers typically price at $1,599. Today Amazon has lowered the price, saving you $150, which can slightly ease the pressure of the price increase.

Apple's 2026 Studio Display hits an all-time Labor Day low on Amazon (savings up to $500)

As part of the Labor Day promotion, yesterday afternoon we saw Amazon drop the 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR to a new all-time low of $329 off; and today we can once again pick up the more affordable Studio Display equipped with Nano-Texture glass and tilt-adjustable stand at its best price, $215 off. See below for details, plus additional savings of up to $500.

Amazon is once again selling the latest 2026 Apple Studio Display equipped with tilt-adjustable stand and Nano-Texture glass for $1,684.88 (shipping included). You need to click the coupon on the page to enjoy this special price.

What you're looking at now is the standard 2026 Apple Studio Display, but with the Nano-Texture glass upgrade and the included tilt-adjustable stand, listed at $1,899. A sticker price of $1,899. Today's deal matches yesterday's — the coupon on the page disappeared at noon, and now it's back again, giving you another shot at Amazon's all-time low price.

  • Apple Studio Display $1,503 (original price $1,599) equipped with tilt-adjustable stand and standard glass
  • Apple Studio Display $1,685 (original price $1,899) — new all-time low, equipped with tilt-adjustable stand and Nano-Texture glass
  • Apple Studio Display XDR $2,970 (original price $3,299) — new all-time low, equipped with tilt and height-adjustable stand and standard glass

Apple's latest 2026 Studio Display isn't exactly cheap even with discounts, but it's really beautiful, and if you're thinking of upgrading, Amazon currently has several models with decent discounts. Don't forget to check the official Apple Refurb Store — some 2026 models currently have discounts of up to $500.

Sony's 2026 BRAVIA 7 II HDR TV drops $800 for Labor Day

Sony's official website is also holding a very attractive Labor Day promotion, with the most notable being their 2026 BRAVIA TVs. Along with deals on some of the latest earbuds, DSLR/mirrorless cameras, etc., we've also tracked discounts of up to $800 on the latest 2026 BRAVIA 7 II and BRAVIA 8 II smart TVs.

  • BRAVIA 7 II 65-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $1,800 (original price $2,600)

More Sony Labor Day TV deals now in progress:

  • BRAVIA 7 II 50-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $1,400 (original price $1,600)
  • BRAVIA 7 II 55-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $1,500 (original price $2,100)
  • BRAVIA 7 II 75-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini $2,300 (original price $3,100)

Apple deals are starting to dwindle, grab AirTag 2 at its all-time low ($20 each) while you can

  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) — tied for all-time low
  • AirTag 2 four-pack $80 (original price $99) — new all-time low

Apple's MagSafe battery is once again on sale at an all-time low of $59, or grab it for $39 through Amazon Resale

Baseus launches Dark Cherry smart display charging series to match your new iPhone 18 Pro [Launch Deal]

Baseus unveiled a brand-new 100W PicoGo Pro smart display charger at its IFA 2026 launch event, and you can now grab it for a launch deal price of $39.99 (shipping included) through the brand's official Amazon store. Remember to enter promo code BSAH2295T at checkout to see the discounted price. This brand-new charger has a regular price of $60, but with the promo code you get $20 off, setting a new all-time low. Available in Dark Cherry and black, both colors can be purchased for $40 right now as part of the launch deal. See below for details.

UGREEN unveils three new Qi2.2 25W MagFlow chargers at IFA, suitable for travel, desktop setups, etc. [Launch Deal]

M6 Mac mini pre-order deals now live on Amazon, shipping this month

With Best Buy and Amazon's Labor Day promotions in full swing, we are also getting closer to the shipping date for the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro models. If you're still on the fence about pre-ordering, be sure to grab the new $9 Apple polishing cloth before it sells out, and check out the discount Amazon is offering on pre-orders of Apple's brand-new Mac mini.

We've introduced these deals individually in previous articles, but we want to make sure they're all in one place so friends still on the fence about pre-ordering can see them at a glance and be prepared before this month's shipping date:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (original price $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (original price $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (original price $1,699)

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Amazon's Anker Labor Day sale officially begins, up to 42% off! Chargers, power banks, Qi2.2 products and more, starting at $12
  • Today's new Beats Solo Buds can be yours for just $35
  • UGREEN 160W smart display charger with retractable cable hits all-time low of $100 again for Labor Day
  • Try a vertical mouse, Acer's textured model is now just $18
  • Wow! AOC's 16-inch portable monitor with two USB-C ports is now just $50
  • ECOVACS unveils the DEEBOT X12S OmniCyclone robot vacuum and mop at IFA 2026, save $300 on launch deal
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro wireless audio transmitter (for use with AirPods) now just $40
  • TESSAN's slim 4-in-1 travel adapter now just $16, toss it in your backpack
  • Add this stainless steel Apple Watch band to your collection for just $11.50 (54% off)
  • Spigen unveils brand-new sporty Apple Magnetic Link-style watch bands starting at $22

Official Apple accessories today starting at $5.50: USB-C cables, Apple Watch bands, more deals

As Amazon's Labor Day sale rolls on, Woot has also launched a major Apple promotion today, with an extra 10% off at checkout. In addition to iPad and MacBook models, there are also plenty of discounts on official Apple accessories — USB-C cables, MagSafe 3 cables, Apple Watch bands, and more. On top of the already discounted prices, you can also use promo code APPLETEN at checkout for an additional 10% off — but please note each customer can only use the code once.

While you'll find plenty of refurbished products here, including iPads and MacBooks, as well as deep discounts on previous-generation products, there are also tons of accessory discounts — for those who don't want to buy refurbished, this is usually the best value in this type of promotion.

***Note: Use promo code APPLETEN at checkout, products in this promotion can get an extra 10% off

  • Apple Watch Sport Band $18 (original price $49)

  • White, Midnight, Starlight, Space Gray, Space Black

  • 1-pack Apple USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable (2m) starting at $63 (original price $147)

iPhone 17 Pro models once again hit new all-time lows on Amazon, up to $285 off (Renewed Premium)

With Best Buy's Labor Day sale (including iPhone Air deals) and Amazon's massive promotion in full swing, we're also seeing decent discounts on the iPhone 17 Pro. While not all colors and configurations are back to last week's prices, we are now tracking new all-time lows on Amazon's highest-quality Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models, with discounts of up to $285. Apple will soon release the new iPhone 18 Pro models, but you can be sure they'll cost a lot more.

As I mentioned before, Amazon Renewed Premium products are the best way to get a deal on a current-generation iPhone (especially the iPhone 17 Pro right now). Apple won't sell these in their official refurbished store, and even if they did in the future, the price would rarely beat Amazon's:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,214 (new unit original price $1,499) — new all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,214 (new unit original price $1,499) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (new unit original price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,149 (new unit original price $1,299) — new all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,165 (new unit original price $1,299) — new all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,171 (new unit original price $1,299)

All of these products come with a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and 'greater than 90% of original battery life'. Be sure to use the link above and watch out for third-party sellers.
